title: Export job slows the database (chain)
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the affected part, the overly frequent cron job as the problem, and the new sales‑export job as the trigger.
root_cause: The newly added sales‑export cron job runs a heavy COPY query every 5 minutes, consuming nearly all DB CPU and causing statement timeouts for other queries, which leads to API errors and nginx returning 502 Bad Gateway.
truth: The new sales-export job was meant to run daily but runs every 5 minutes. Its huge export query keeps PostgreSQL busy, so the api's queries time out, its workers are killed, and nginx answers 502. web and api only show the effect.
